results.fragment: 'negative critical reception' refers to percentage of movies with a rating of 1, which = [count(rating = 1) / count(all movies)] * 100%
percentage of winning at the home = Divide(homeWon, won) * 100
more than 50 games won refers to won > 50
team with 90% games won refers to Divide (won, games) > 0.9
team with winning rate less than 50% refers to Divide (won, Sum(won, lost)) < 0.5
played more than 3800 points refers to Sum(points) > = 3800
higher than 75 inch refers to height > 75
minimum weight refers to Min(weight)
team with at least 3 all star player refers to tmID where Count(player_allstar.playerID) > = 3
BMI = Multiply(Divide(weight, Multiply(height, height)), 703)
average BMI refers to AVG (Multiply(Divide(weight, Multiply(height, height)), 703))
average height refers to avg(height)
more than 2 different teams refers to count(tmID) > 2
all free throw attempted successfully made refers to ftAttempted > 0 and ftAttempted = ftMade
the most rebounds refers to max(rebounds)
highest median income refers to Max(Median Income)
highest net profit = Max(Subtract (Unit Price, Unit Cost))
highest discount applied refers to Max(Discount Applied)
highest sales order unit price refers to Max(Unit Price)
average land area = Divide (Sum(Land Area), Count(Land Area))
order date after 1/1/2018 refers to OrderDate > '1/1/2018'
highest unit price refers to Max(Unit Price)
most discount refers to Max(Discount Applied)
order quantity greater than 5 refers to Order Quantity > 5
most populous country refers to Max(Population)
highest unit price refers to Max(Unit Price)
median income no more than 30,000 refers to Median Income < 30,000
